newsitem.title: USA: Teletouch names Carlson president and COO.
newsitem.headline: Teletouch names Carlson president and COO.

text.p: Teletouch Communications Inc said Tuesday that J. Richard Carlson has been named president and chief operating officer.
The company said he succeeds G. David Higginbotham, who will continue as a director and manage its network operations.
Prior to joining Teletouch Carlson was vice-president of Marketing for IDB Mobile Communications, a provider of mobile satellite services.
Teletouch provides paging services in Alabama, Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Texas and Tennessee, focusing on smaller lerss-competitive metropolitan markets.
